text: Optical STDP in a PCM synapse is a global, supervised learning rule that requires backpropagation through the entire network.
explanation: False. Optical STDP is local and unsupervised (Hebbian): pre/post pulse coincidence at the PCM synapse sets the weight via SET/RESET. It is surrogate-gradient (BPTT) training that is global, supervised, and backprop-based, and that method runs offline in software rather than on-chip.
